subject: Pricing & commit options for high-throughput hosted API (Nimbus Commerce)
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex@nimbuscommerce.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Baseline hosted API rate card & commit options for evaluation

Hi Jonas,

Quick intro — I run Platform Partnerships at Nimbus Commerce. We're evaluating hosted LLM providers for a multi-service rollout (customer support automation + ranking + embeddings search). Our engineering forecast shows ~500M tokens/month in steady state with short peaks up to ~1B tokens for seasonal traffic.

Could you share:
- Redwood hosted baseline rate card (hosted API, per-1k token pricing)
- Typical tiered/volume discount schedule for >100M / >250M / >500M / >1B tokens
- Details on burst capacity and how overage is billed if we exceed committed bands
- Any pilot/credit options for a 30-day production pilot
- Whether multi-region or cross-region usage affects pricing (we'll run US + EU)

Happy to hop on a call if easier — looking to collect concrete pricing to present to finance next week.

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Platform Partnerships | Nimbus Commerce
alex@nimbuscommerce.com
+1 (415) 555-0114
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Alex Morgan <alex@nimbuscommerce.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Baseline hosted API rate card & commit options for evaluation

Alex — thanks for the details and the ask. Quick clarifying questions so I can put the right numbers together:

1) Mix: do you expect the 500M tokens to be mostly generation (chat/completion) or are embeddings/rerank a large slice? Embeddings cost characteristics differ.
2) Peak behaviour: you mentioned short peaks up to 1B tokens — are those short spikes (hours/days) or sustained (weeks)?
3) Model preferences: do you plan to use a single model family (e.g., Redwood-1 variants) or mix with smaller open models for embedding use cases?
4) Are you open to a 12-month committed plan with step-up breakpoints? That materially changes the discount curve.

I'll pull a preliminary hosted rate card and a couple of commit scenarios (12-month vs month-to-month with buffered burst credits). If it helps, I can include our Senior Pricing lead (Laura Bennett) and Sales Ops (Ben Carter) in the thread to formalize a proposal.

Would you be available for a 30-minute sync tomorrow 11:00 PT?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
From: Alex Morgan <alex@nimbuscommerce.com>

Date: 2026-08-29T11:15:00-07:00

Jonas — answers inline:

1) Mix: roughly 60% generation (series of short prompts + chat flows), 25% embeddings (search + vector store refresh), 15% reranking/other.
2) Peaks: mostly short-lived (hours) around promotional blasts, but we expect 2–3 sustained days during big sales.
3) Model mix: primary preference is high-quality Redwood-1-like generation for customer-facing flows; embeddings can use smaller open models.
4) We are open to a 12-month commit if the economics are compelling and there's a pilot window.

We can do 11:00 PT tomorrow — I'll send a calendar invite. Also please include finance/pricing folks on your side.

Appreciate it,
Alex
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex@nimbuscommerce.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Nimbus pricing ask — please draft commit scenarios and rate card

Laura/Ben — forwarding Nimbus's ask (see below). They expect ~500M tokens/mo with short spikes to 1B. They prefer hosted, open to 12-month commit.

Request: please draft 2 clean options we can present:
A) 12-month committed plan with 4 tier breakpoints (100M, 250M, 500M, 1B) including unit price per 1k tokens, overage rate, and burst buffer mechanics (how many burst credits/month and how they're billed). Include SLA credit terms for sustained outage.
B) Month-to-month hosted with buffered burst credits and pilot credit (30 days) — include higher per-token rates and clear overage step.

Attach preliminary ratecard and a workbook for scenario math (attached). I'd like this by EOD tomorrow so we can present on the sync.

Thanks — Jonas
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex@nimbuscommerce.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus pricing ask — draft commit scenarios attached

Thanks — drafting now. High-level draft below (attach pricing PDF + workbook):

Proposal A — 12-month committed plan (preferred economics)
- Baseline (no commit): $0.025 per 1k tokens (generation), $0.003 per 1k tokens (embeddings)
- Commit tiers (effective per-1k token price after commit):
  - 100M+: $0.018 gen / $0.0022 emb
  - 250M+: $0.014 gen / $0.0018 emb
  - 500M+: $0.011 gen / $0.0015 emb
  - 1B+: $0.0085 gen / $0.0012 emb
- Overage: charged at 110% of committed tier rate for the month (auto-billed as usage overage).
- Burst buffer: included 20% of committed monthly token amount as free burst credits (resets monthly). Excess burst billed at overage rate.
- Pilot: 30-day pilot — $50k in test credits usable for any traffic, applied as prepayment toward first invoice if they convert to commit within 45 days.
- Multi-region: cross-region ingress is included; egress to EU has a 5% surcharge on token rates to cover multi-region infra.
- SLA credits: standard hosted SLA (99.9%) with credits up to 10% of monthly invoice for sustained downtime > 2 hrs (per SLA table).

Proposal B — Month-to-month hosted
- Generation: $0.030 per 1k tokens; Embeddings: $0.004 per 1k tokens
- Burst buffer: 10% free burst credits; overage billed at 120% of baseline rate
- Pilot: 30-day $30k credit (no commitment)

Notes/asks for sales:
- Ben: please run margin sensitivity for the 500M and 1B scenarios (assume mixed model split above and Redwood-1 usage for gen).
- Jonas: we'll include a clause that allows 1x contractual tier re-evaluation at month 6 if usage consistently exceeds projections.

Attachments: nimbus_prelim_ratecard_v1.pdf, nimbus_commit_scenarios.xlsx

Laura Bennett
Senior Pricing Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex@nimbuscommerce.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus pricing ask — draft commit scenarios attached

Laura — this looks good. A couple of small edits before I send to Nimbus:

1) Overage: tighten to 105% of committed tier rate for the first 2 months of an overage to give them runway; revert to 110% thereafter.
2) Burst buffer: make the 20% buffer explicit as available for intra-month spikes with automatic top-up billing at the overage rate.
3) Pilot credits: prefer the $50k pilot for the 12-month path but add a clause that any unused pilot credits convert to a first-month reduction (incentive to convert).
4) Add a short paragraph on model parity: we guarantee Redwood-1-large parity for critical customer-facing flows; smaller open variants will be billed per the embedding table.

Ben — please confirm margin sensitivity and whether finance needs additional guardrails. If no redlines, I'm happy to send this to Alex with the attachments and a suggested SLA/commit language.

If Alex is good with this we can aim to finalize commercial terms next week and start the 30-day pilot within 10 business days of signing.

Thanks — Jonas
